title: What is the alternative way to use the max method in condition in workflow

posts.name: manal alsubaei
posts.cooked:
int(frappe.db.get_list("User Group Member", filters={"user": frappe.session.user},fields=['parent'], ignore_permissions=True)[0].parent.replace('Level ', '') or 0) ==   max( [int(item['parent'].replace('Level ', '')) for item in frappe.db.get_list("User Group Member", filters=[["user","in", frappe.db.get_list('ToDo', filters=[['reference_type', '=','Task'], ['reference_name', '=',name], ['status', '!=','Cancelled']], pluck='allocated_to')]],  fields=['parent'], ignore_permissions=True) ] )

int(frappe.db.get_list(“User Group Member”, filters={“user”: frappe.session.user},fields=[‘parent’], ignore_permissions=True)[0].parent.replace('Level ', ‘’) or 0) == sorted( [int(item[‘parent’].replace('Level ', ‘’)) for item in frappe.db.get_list(“User Group Member”, filters=[[“user”,“in”, frappe.db.get_list(‘ToDo’, filters=[[‘reference_type’, ‘=’,‘Task’], [‘reference_name’, ‘=’,name], [‘status’, ‘!=’,‘Cancelled’]], pluck=‘allocated_to’)]], fields=[‘parent’], ignore_permissions=True) ] )
